The Nevada Department of Fish and Game says, "Suspension of hunting and fishing licenses is now the responsibility of the State and that is where it should remain."
Only Federal permits or stamps are subject to suspension under the proposed legislation, and further, only after conviction of a criminal or knowing violation of the Act-- no State licenses or permits are involved.

There is no question that the provision is somewhat discriminating against hunting and fishing license holders, but these individuals happen to be among those brought in contact with wildlife. Not all potential violators of the proposed legislation have quite the same degree of vulnerability to punishment. In the interest of enforcement of the Act, all means available should be utilized. For example, the proposed legislation also provides in the same section for modification, suspension, or revocation of licenses or permits for grazing livestock on Federal lands held by individuals convicted of criminal violation of provisions of the Act.
